notes.title: [1.4.0] Cats Go! 1/17 Update Notice
notes.content:
[h2][b]📢[1.4.0] 1/17Update Notice[/b][/h2]

Hello, Cats Go! Players!
Thank you for your continued love and support for Cats Go!
We’re excited to share the main details of the [1.4.0] update, released on January 17th.


[b][h3]1. New Characters Added[/h3]
[list]
[*]Two unique and exciting new characters have been added!
[/list]
[h3]- Bobo[/h3]
(Unlock: Clear the [Shy Snowman] map)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169116/cf6355efe8825579c06282d161a3d386cb05d9d4.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Trait: Moves slowly but boasts incredible strength.
[*] Special Skill: Attack power increases based on the amount of meat held.
[/olist]
[h3]- Catfy[/h3]
(Unlock: Clear the [Autumn Night] map)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169116/bd8fdfb94d99086c6934773baceae3d840256220.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Trait: Moves quickly but has relatively low attack power.
[*] 특수 스킬:Special Skill: [Meat Giving] and [Upgrading] speeds are doubled.
[/olist]

[b][h3]2. Improved Character Selection Controls[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] The character selection screen has been improved to provide a more convenient and user-friendly experience.
[/list]

[b][h3]3. Steam Achievements Added[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] Two new achievements for clearing specific maps have been added!
[Shy Snowman], [Autumn Night]
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new features and characters in Cats Go!
As always, your feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: [1.3.0] Cats Go! 12/23 Update Notice
notes.content:
[h2][b]📢 12/23 Upcoming Update Notice [1.3.0][/b][/h2]

Hello, Cats Go! players!
The new Cats Go! update has arrived on December 23rd! 
With this [1.3.0] version, we’ve added various features and content to enhance your gaming experience.

[b][h3]1. Two New Maps Added[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] Christmas Map: Enjoy thrilling battles in the winter Christmas map!
Cliff Map: A strategic and exhilarating cliff-themed map has been added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169116/b99e94f1ed1c2bba340eee05f243f4be974f3261.png[/img]

[b][h3]2. Character Selection Feature[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] Choose your favorite character in the lobby or character selection screen!
[/list]
[b][h3]3. Restricted Construction Area Display[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] When constructing plants, areas where construction is not allowed will now be visually marked on the map.
[/list]


Update now and experience the improved Cats Go!

notes.title: [1.1.0] Cats Go! 11/27 Update Notice
notes.content:
[b][h2]📢 11/27 Update Notice [1.1.0][/h2][/b]
Hello, Cats Go players!

Here are the details of the [1.1.0] update on November 27th.

[b][h3]1. Two New Monsters Added[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Two new monsters have been added to the game.
[/list]

[b][h3]2. Bomb Range Display Feature Added[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Bomb range is now displayed, allowing you to throw bombs more accurately to stop monsters and opposing players.
[/list]

[b][h3]3. Meat Drop Feature When Stunned[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Players hit by poisonous mushrooms or bombs will drop a certain amount of meat when stunned.
[i](Throw bombs to steal meat from other players!)[/i]
[/list]

[b][h3]4. Exit Confirmation Popup in Lobby[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] A confirmation popup is now displayed when exiting the lobby.
[/list]

[b][h3]5. Wave Waiting Time Adjusted Based on Player Count[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Wave waiting times are now automatically adjusted based on the number of players.
[/list]

Enjoy a more strategic and exciting Cats Go experience with this update! 😊

notes.title: [1.0.3] Cats Go! 11/22 Update Notice
notes.content:
[b][h2]📢 11/22 Update Notice [1.0.3][/h2][/b]

Hello, Cats Go players!

Here are the details of the [1.0.3] update coming on November 22nd.

[b][h3]1. Two New Maps Added[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Two new themed maps, Ruins and Beach, have been added alongside the existing maps.

[list]
[*] A new feature has been added, allowing you to select plants for battle directly. Choose your plants in the lobby and enjoy strategic gameplay with various combinations!
[/list]

Enjoy the enhanced Cats Go experience with this update!

notes.title: [1.0.2] Cats Go! 11/06 Update Notice
notes.content:
[b][h2]📢 11/06 Update Notes [1.0.2][/h2][/b]

Hello, Cats Go players!

Here are the details of the [1.0.2] update on November 6th.

[b][h3]1. New Maps[/h3][/b] [list] [*] Two new maps have been added, each themed around winter and autumn. [/list]

[b][h3]2. Attack Controls Update[/h3][/b] [list] [*] Continuous attacks are now possible by holding down the basic attack key. [/list]

[b][h3]3. Plant Turret Level Adjustment[/h3][/b] [list] [*] The maximum level of the plant turret has been adjusted from 3 to 5. Modeling for the additional levels will be included in a future update. [/list]

[b][h3]4. Sound Settings Added[/h3][/b] [list] [*] New options to adjust master volume, background music, and sound effects are now available. [/list]

[b][h3]5. In-Game Discord Access[/h3][/b] [list] [*] You can now access the Discord channel easily from within the game. [/list]

[b][h3]6. Automatic Controller Key Change[/h3][/b] [list] [*] When a controller is connected, the key guide UI in-game will automatically adjust. [/list]

[b][h3]7. Difficulty Adjustment[/h3][/b] [list] [*] With the addition of Autumn (Normal) and Winter (Easy) modes, the difficulty of the original map (Hard) has been increased. [/list]

Enjoy an even more exciting Cats Go experience with this update!

notes.title: [1.0.2] Cats Go! 11/5 Upcoming Update Notice
notes.content:

Hello, Cats Go! players!

Look forward to an even better Cats Go! after this update!

notes.title: [1.0.1] Cats Go! 10/30 Update Notice
notes.content:
[b][h2]📢 10/30 Update Notice [1.0.1][/h2]
[/b]
Hello, Cats Go! players!

Here’s an overview of the updates from October 30.


[b][h3]1. Steam Deck Build Stabilization[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] The game has been modified to run smoothly in the Steam Deck environment.
[/list]
[b][h3]2. Improved Plant Turret Health Recovery and Upgrade Interaction[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] The health recovery and upgrade process for plant turrets have been made more convenient.
[/list][i]Old: Pressing the button once triggers a single attack.
New: Pressing the button starts the attack, and pressing it again or moving will cancel it.[/i]

[b][h3]3. Change in In-Game Text[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] The phrase "Game Start" in the main menu has been changed to "Quick Start."
[/list]

Enjoy an even more fun Cats Go! with this update!
